subject: Urgent: production latency & 5xx spike after quant-profile rollout — PrimeWay
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@primeway.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: sre-team@primeway.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Production spike after quant-profile v2 rollout

Karthik —

We just saw a sudden increase in p99 latency (~2.3x) and a 1.8% 5xx rate across our inference route within 6 minutes of the 'quant-profile v2' rollout you ran at 08:45 PDT. Traffic pattern hasn't changed on our side. The error payloads point to kernel timeouts and OOM traces from the model host.

This is affecting live traffic for our clinical triage feature; affects ~7% of user sessions. We need immediate mitigation: can you revert to the previous profile or pin to the prior variant? Please advise ETA.

I've attached a couple of graphs and a trace export (p99_latency_spike_20270712.png, trace_span_9a7b.json).

Alice
SRE, PrimeWay Health

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@primeway.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production spike after quant-profile v2 rollout

Alice —

Thank you for the heads up and for the trace. I'm opening an incident and pulling the infra/serving team into this now. Initial ask: we'll start a rollback to the last known good variant (redwood-model-7b-fp16-v1) across PrimeWay's pool and hold any further quant-profile changes. ETA for rollback start is ~20-30 minutes; I'll confirm once the canary completes.

Cc'ing Markus (serving runtime) and Monica (customer success) — Markus, initial look? Monica, I'll loop back on credits / customer messaging once we have containment.

- Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@primeway.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production spike after quant-profile v2 rollout

Karthik / Monica / Alice —

Thanks for the signal, Alice. Quick technical summary from our end after looking at the trace: the quant-profile v2 moves more ops onto an experimental fused kernel path for attention. On the current GPU fleet we see increased kernel latency for sequences with high prefix reuse (which PrimeWay has), and a small memory fragmentation pattern causing transient OOMs in the worker process under burst.

Immediate mitigation plan (we can do ASAP):
- Start rollback to redwood-model-7b-fp16-v1 on PrimeWay's dedicated pool. This reverts to the stable kernel path.
- Disable automatic global rollout of quant-profile v2 and quarantine the profile locally.
- Run a controlled canary (5% of traffic) for 10 minutes, measure p50/p95/p99 and error rate.

I am attaching a perf summary and the raw perf CSV we pulled from the cluster (perf_summary_quant_v2.csv). If rollback doesn't contain, we'll provision a temporary burst pool with the prior profile.

Markus
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@primeway.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: bob.liu <bob.liu@primeway.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production spike after quant-profile v2 rollout

Thanks — please proceed with the rollback and canary. For timeline: PrimeWay needs containment within 60 minutes. Also we'll want a post-incident summary and a proposed rollout gating checklist before any future quant changes.

If you can confirm rollback started and provide the canary telemetry link, that'd be great. We're tracking this with our incident commander.

Alice

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Exec summary / decision: PrimeWay regression

Quick executive note for the thread and for records:
- Impact: PrimeWay production p99 latency spike (~2x) and ~1.8% 5xx after quant-profile v2 rollout at 08:45 PDT. Customer-facing.
- Immediate decision: authorize rollback to redwood-model-7b-fp16-v1 and pause all v2 rollouts.
- Commercial ask: approve a one-month service credit to PrimeWay for the affected routes and priority postmortem. Monica, please draft the credit note and get finance approval.
- Next steps: Markus to confirm containment and provide telemetry summary; postmortem scheduled + retention of all traces/metrics for 30 days.

Please prioritize containment and keep me posted. If rollback completes and customer is stable, prepare a short exec-facing timeline and root-cause hypothesis (no more than one page).

Marissa
VP, Customer & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@primeway.com>, bob.liu <bob.liu@primeway.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production spike after quant-profile v2 rollout — rollback complete

Alice / Bob —

Rollback to redwood-model-7b-fp16-v1 completed at 10:38 PDT and canary (5% traffic) ran for 12 minutes with p99 and 5xx returning to baseline. We pushed the stable profile to 100% at 10:52 PDT. We've attached the post-rollback telemetry snapshot and a PNG of the p99 trend (p99_latency_spike_20270712.png).

Thanks for your patience — Monica will follow up on the service credit and the postmortem. Short do / don'ts while we investigate: do not re-enable quant-profile v2 in PrimeWay's environment; we'll work with your SREs on a thorough gating checklist and a controlled re-validation process.

Action items we own:
- Full postmortem (delivery in 72 hours) with root-cause and rollout guard checklist (Markus).
- Credit note and customer compensation (Monica).
- Retain traces/metrics and kernel-level logs for 30 days (Infra).

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
